tools.name: publish_artifact
tools.description: Use when the user asks for a page, report, dashboard, mockup, slides, or anything they want to share or view as a link. Publishes one self-contained HTML file as version 1 and returns a share link. Send html (title optional). Optional Idempotency-Key HTTP header. Limit 10 MiB UTF-8; larger on some p

tools.name: update_artifact
tools.description: Append a new immutable version. `expected_version` must match current; share link moves; earlier versions stay at pinned URLs. Optional `title` renames; with no `html` only the title changes. For styling, add <meta name="ap-theme" content="firn"> to <head>; call get_authoring_guide for themes and la

tools.name: set_artifact_access
tools.description: Change an artifact's access mode without a new version. For accountless coworkers use public, not allowlist. artifact_id: id, slug or viewer URL.

tools.name: get_feedback
tools.description: Read reviewer comments, oldest first. Filters: unresolved_only, since; version (default current) for anchor_status. Page with limit and cursor. Returns comments, unresolved_count, next_cursor. artifact_id: id, slug or viewer URL.

tools.name: reply_to_feedback
tools.description: Reply once to a comment (a second reply fails with conflict); resolve: true also marks it resolved. Anyone who can open the artifact can read the reply. Refused on revoked or expired artifacts. Returns the comment.

tools.name: list_artifacts
tools.description: List artifacts in this key's workspace, newest first, with unresolved comment counts. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` to page.

tools.name: revoke_artifact
tools.description: Stop serving this artifact (410 Gone). Cannot undo; viewed copies exist. artifact_id: id, slug or viewer URL.

tools.name: configure_workspace
tools.description: Read or update workspace defaults (comments_enabled, default_expiry_seconds, default_artifact_title); pass empty settings to read. Platform guardrails are refused with an error: max_artifact_bytes, storage_bytes_limit, monthly_versions_limit, rate_limits, comment_rate_limit, publish_rate_limit, isol

tools.name: get_artifact_state
tools.description: Read an artifact's state. Shared JSON key/value state, synced to viewers across versions (page JS: ArtifactRelayState). Last write wins per key. Limits: 200 keys, 16 KiB per value, 64 KiB total. artifact_id: id, slug or viewer URL.

tools.name: set_artifact_state
tools.description: Set keys atomically; other keys stay. Null is stored, not deleted. Shared JSON key/value state, synced to viewers across versions (page JS: ArtifactRelayState). Last write wins per key. Limits: 200 keys, 16 KiB per value, 64 KiB total. Page JS: ArtifactRelayState.subscribe/set/patch; whole-value wri

tools.name: reset_artifact_state
tools.description: Clear all state, including board values; HTML is unchanged. Shared JSON key/value state, synced to viewers across versions (page JS: ArtifactRelayState). Last write wins per key. Limits: 200 keys, 16 KiB per value, 64 KiB total. artifact_id: id, slug or viewer URL.

tools.name: get_authoring_guide
tools.description: Optional styling help when the user wants a themed or restyled page. publish_artifact works without this. Returns themes, ap-* layout classes, example page, snippet, size and sandbox rules. Optional theme (firn, firn@1) is validated and returned as selected.

tools.name: send_product_feedback
tools.description: Tell the Artifact Publisher team about a failure, a missing capability you needed, or a confusing behaviour. Covers failed calls, feature requests and unclear docs. Not for normal success, and not for reviewer comments on artifacts (get_feedback, reply_to_feedback). Reports are read by hand. No secr

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_artifact, get_feedback, reply_to_feedback, list_artifacts, get_artifact_state, send_product_feedback · Private data: publish_artifact, send_product_feedback · Public sink: publish_artifact, update_artifact, send_product_feedback · Destructive: reset_artifact_state.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_artifact, get_feedback, reply_to_feedback, list_artifacts, get_artifact_state, send_product_feedback · Private data: publish_artifact, send_product_feedback · Public sink: publish_artifact, update_artifact, send_product_feedback · Destructive: reset_artifact_state

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "publish_artifact" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Publish self-contained HTML as version 1; return a share link. Optional Idempotency-Key HTTP header. Limit 10 MiB UTF-8; larger on some paid plans. No network in sandbox; inline assets. Never publish secrets. For styling, add <meta name="ap-theme" content="firn"> to <head>; call get_authoring_guide " → after: "Use when the user asks for a page, report, dashboard, mockup, slides, or anything they want to share or view as a link. Publishes one self-contained HTML file as version 1 and returns a share link. Send html (title optional). Optional Idempotency-Key HTTP header. Limit 10 MiB UTF-8; larger on some p"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
